name: Website Design Change
description: Make a visual or layout change to the tachin.ai marketing website — hero treatment, section design, spacing, color, typography application, responsive behavior. Always applies the Tachin design system; never invents new visual language. Use for any change about how the site LOOKS.

target_pages.description: Which page(s) or section(s) to change

steps.title: Understand the request against the design system
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP.

Prepare the design change: ${request}

1. Read docs/design/TACHIN_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md in full — tokens, components, principles.
2. Read the current markup/styles for ${target_pages} from sites/tachin-website/.
3. Identify which design-system tokens and components apply.
4. Write a short design proposal: what changes, which tokens/components are used, and why it fits the system. If the request would require a NEW token or component, flag it explicitly — new design language needs owner sign-off, not improvisation.
steps.accept_criteria: Proposal names specific tokens/components from the design system. Any new-token need is flagged. No improvised visual language.

steps.title: Design proposal review
steps.description: Present the design proposal to the owner. Include: the change, the tokens/components used, and a description (or static mockup link) of the result.
steps.approval_message: 🎨 Design proposal ready for ${target_pages}. Review and reply approve or reject before implementation.
steps.accept_criteria: Owner approved or rejected the proposal.

steps.title: Implement the design change
steps.description:
Implement the approved design in a working branch.

1. Create branch design/${target_pages}-update.
2. Apply changes using ONLY design-system tokens (CSS custom properties) and documented components.
3. Edit the shared stylesheet at sites/tachin-website/styles.css and the page markup as needed.
4. Ensure responsive behavior at the documented breakpoints (mobile 375, tablet 768, desktop 1280).
5. Save complete modified files.
steps.accept_criteria: Change implemented using design-system tokens only. Responsive at all three breakpoints. No hardcoded colors/spacing outside the token set.

steps.title: Design self-check
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT modify anything.

Verify:
1. Diff against main — confirm changes are scoped to the request.
2. Confirm every color/space/font value is a design-system token, not a hardcoded literal.
3. Confirm responsive behavior at 375 / 768 / 1280.
4. Confirm no regression to other sections sharing the same styles.
steps.accept_criteria: All values are tokens. Responsive verified. No regressions. Diff scoped to request.
